items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15

ctx.x: How do you do? Good to know you. I'm Mr. Monetta, Professor Monetta, Mr. Thompson. All right, Mr. Thompson.
You met Mr. Russell. I believe he was able to do Mr. Thompson. Mr. Collins. How do you do? How do you do? Please meet Mr. Thompson.
